caption: The drawing depicts a piece of clothing, specifically a garment with two wide sleeves, rendered in delicate, muted tones. The main body of the garment appears to be made from a light, off-white or cream-colored fabric, shown with irregular folds and subtle brownish stains or discolorations. The edges of the garment, particularly around the openings for the arms, are adorned with ornate, circular lace details. The lace is intricate, light gray in color, and consists of repeating geometric and floral patterns. The upper edge of the garment, where the two lace-trimmed sleeves meet, is gathered or ruffled, adding texture to the composition. The background consists of an unembellished, light beige or off-white surface, which contrasts with and highlights the garment and its lace embellishments. In the lower right corner, there is faint, small text, but it does not intrude upon the central depiction of the clothing item.
title: Under Bodice
